Paste a token and Nymbot lists what it c: Whakoputoputo i tētahi token ka whakaaturia e Nymbot ngā mea e taea e ia te rapu, kia kōwhiria ai e koe ngā pātaka e hiahia ana i te mea kaua e tuhia tētahi tēnei i te ingoa mō ia mea kia tika ai. Ko ngā rapunga Pro ka pānui i rātou nei te kōdi, ā, ki te whakatika i te tuhi, ka tukuna, ka wāhanga, ā, ka tuwhera ngā pātengi kōdi (pull requests). Ko te rārangi e pātai ana tēnei tapuramu, mai i te forge; ka tuku ngā token rārangi i ia tono, ā, kāore e tūhono ki te taha pāoma, e kore hoki e whakaputa ki ngā relay. Ki te whakatata i te sync, ka haere rātou ki ōu tapuramu atu, kua hūmārie ki tō kī ake anake.

Tuhingia he token ka whakarārangihia e Nymbot ngā mea e taea e ia te tae atu, kia kōwhiri ai koe i ngā pātengi mea kōrero e hiahia ana i te mea kaua e tuhia iwi iwi i te ingoa tika, Pro e pānui ana i tō rānei kōti, ā, me te whakawhiti kōrero, ka tukuna, ka whakatakoto, ka whakatuwhera rānei i ngā tono pūtake. Ki te tēnei tapohi e pātai atu ai te rārangi, mai i te pāhanga; ka tiakina ngā token whakawhiti i konei anake, ā, ka tuku i ia tono — kaua e tiakina i te taha tūmatanui, mēnā rānei ka whakaputa ki ngā whakaputa rārangi.
